<!-- merge-digest:begin -->
## Merge digest

**What changed:** The `bin/review-outcomes report` command now prints cycles-to-pass per PR and a monthly count of revert commits on `origin/master`.

**Why:** The plan wants a cheap health check on the review loop, so a reviewer change that cuts findings can be checked against any rise in reverts.

**Watch:** The bug-planting block in the PR body predates commit `0468bbda`, so its flags on rows 7, 11 and 25 are stale. `build_cycles` undercounts cycles because a review run with zero findings writes no event.

**Touches:** bin/review-outcomes, tools/postplan-harness/harness/outcome_log.py, tools/postplan-harness/README.md, tools/postplan-harness/tests/

**Machine-authored fixes:** pending — Phase 6.5 has not run
<!-- merge-digest:end -->

## Summary
- `report` in `tools/postplan-harness/harness/outcome_log.py` now prints two extra stats after the outcome table: cycles-to-pass per PR and reverts on `origin/master`.
- Cycles come from the raw `phase4.5` events. A new cycle starts when two events of one PR are more than 300 seconds apart. A PR counts toward `--since`/`--until` by the UTC day of its last `phase4.5` event.
- The text output shows mean, median, max and a 1/2/3/4+ histogram. Review runs that logged zero findings write no event, so the stat undercounts. The output says so.
- Reverts are commits on `origin/master` whose subject starts with `Revert "`. They are grouped by UTC month, with the month's commit total beside each count.
- If `git log` fails, the text says the count is unavailable and `--json` carries `"reverts": null`. The error goes to stderr and the exit code stays 0.
- The existing table and existing JSON keys are unchanged. The new data sits under new `cycles` and `reverts` keys.
- Added tests for cycle gap edges, sweep events being ignored, date range handling, bad timestamps, revert subject near-misses, month bucketing, and git failure paths.
- Updated two existing test files to read only the table part of the output, since extra sections now follow it.
- `bin/review-outcomes` header comment and `tools/postplan-harness/README.md` now describe the `report` command and the two new stats.

**Merge danger:** Door: two-way · Blast radius: site-wide · Why: Read-only report addition in dev tooling; no data written, no migration, no GM-facing change.
**How to revert:** `git revert <merge-sha>`; no migration, prod sync or config step is involved.
